speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (a) what are the considerations that led to the identification of the industrial area along Bukit Batok Street 23 as one of the four funeral parlour sites to be developed in the next 10 years; and (b) what are the mitigation measures that will be put in place to minimise the impact on residents living nearby.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This is to meet the growing demand for after-death facilities and services as our population ages.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The sites were carefully studied and identified through an interagency planning process.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: They are distributed across Singapore to provide better accessibility for bereaved families and their visitors.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The site in the industrial area along Bukit Batok Street 23 will cater to the demand for funeral parlour services in the western part of Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The site is surrounded by industrial developments and is located next to an existing columbarium.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Rituals and funeral processions will be confined within the site as far as possible, to minimise disturbance.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: NEA will also work with the other agencies and the operator to reduce the impact of hearses when they move in the area.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This can include ensuring accessibility via different routes and avoiding roads within residential estates as far as possible.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As a small and densely populated city state, there will always be competing demands for space to meet Singapore’s various development needs.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: From time to time, we may have to make adjustments to accommodate these developments.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through careful planning and by taking mitigating measures, the Government will make the best effort to minimise potential disamenities arising from these developments.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: First, may I ask whether distance from the housing estate is a factor to be considered in deciding which funeral site should be zoned, and if so, why is it that the Bukit Batok site was chosen, given that the nearest housing estate is about 200 metres away from the proposed funeral site?

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: The second question I have is whether in relation to the other three funeral parlour sites, the housing estates are as close or are they further?

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: The third question I have is in relation to mitigation measures.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: I am glad to hear that there are proposals to consider designating hearse routes.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: The second question on, hearse routes, when we put out the tender for the funeral operators to build and design the funeral parlour, we will put this as part of the requirements for their proposal, such as what they will do, where they will route.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We also advise them where are the best routes to take, to avoid the residents and Housing and Development Board (HDB) flats as far as possible.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: The 200 metres was not the exact reason why we did it.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: For Bukit Batok, first, as I mentioned, there is a dearth of such facilities in the western region.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: If you look at the map, the nearest one is in Choa Chu Kang.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: It is not so accessible, very far for many people.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: If you do not have a car, it is quite difficult to get there.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: So, we think it is useful to have one in that area.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Even so, when the operators come to build, we will ask them to build enough shielding, so that noise, disamenities or even sight can be mitigated.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Among the four sites selected, one of them is in my constituency.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Just now, my Parliamentary colleague asked about the hearse route.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: In fact, there has been a lot of feedback from residents because, currently, quite a lot of them are using the route passing by Meng Suan estate.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, as far as possible, try to reduce using that route, but perhaps can come from another side of Mandai Road.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We, as Singaporeans living in HDB estates, are very used to seeing funeral wakes at the void decks, and now, perhaps more frequently than before.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: This is one big-hearted society where we have never minded seeing either funerals or weddings right below where we live.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: As Members know, where funerals are conducted, even weddings, there are disamenities, and we have tolerated them for a long, long time ever since we have had HDB flats.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We should keep that sense of accommodation, that sense of respect for people who need this in times of bereavement.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: At the same time, there are also people who want to choose other options where perhaps they want a quieter place to grieve for their loved ones.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: We also want to make sure that the religious beliefs and cultural preferences are also being met.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: So, for a change, Er Dr Lee Bee Wah is not actively canvassing for the facility in her area.
